caption: The drawing shows a full-length figure of a person standing on a rectangular, dark gray pedestal. The figure is shown in profile facing to the left. The person wears a green long-sleeved shirt or jacket decorated with gold or yellow trim, and a brown sleeveless fringed tunic that reaches above the knees. Over the wolf brown garment, a brownish-red sash or blanket is draped over the left shoulder and down the back. The figure wears reddish, brown, and tan moccasin-style footwear. On the head is a large feathered headdress featuring alternating plumes of red, yellow, and green. The person’s hair is black, and the skin is a brown tone. They hold a long musket vertically in front of their body with both hands, left hand higher, and a tomahawk or hatchet is attached to a belt or hanging from the right hip. The background is a plain, unmarked beige or light tan color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
